The '''podracers' hovel''' was a place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracers]] came to play cards, listen to music and relax between [[Podracing/Legends|races]]. Famous racers such as [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were regular visitors of the hovel. It featured a [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]], a wall screen with a broadcast of the ''[[Fode and Beed Show/Legends|Fode and Beed Show]]'', and small stage on which dancing numbers were performed.<ref name="AS" />
